what_it_is: Production e-commerce site for Lunnheim, a Norwegian art-piece/print brand. Next.js 13+ App Router + Sanity (visual editing, react-loader), tRPC, Tailwind, React Email, Fathom. Full shop: pieces catalog with frame/material/size configurator, shopping cart, Stripe checkout, Klarna pay-now/pay-later added May 2025. Journal/categories content sections. Route-colocated Sanity schemas (schema lives next to the page it feeds).
frikk_role: Lead developer and maintainer over ~2.5 years; built the shop, product page UX (mobile product page iterations, size slider, frame options), Stripe ElementsForm, and the 2025 Klarna integration (1552-line commit 55fe375). Suman contributed platform/infra chunks.
hardest_problems: Real payment flows (Stripe Elements, then retrofitting Klarna into a live shop), a physical-product configurator (frames, materials, sizes) driven from CMS data, and Sanity visual-editing/preview plumbing across a route-colocated schema architecture.
evidence: src/app/stripe/, src/components/shopping-cart/, src/app/(site)/pieces/[...slug]/components/mobile-product-page-2/, commit 55fe375 'Klarna' (8 files, +1552), e44286e 'Pay now or later with Klarna' 2025-05-13
grade_why: Flagship of the Lunnheim family (with Lunnheim v1 prototype and starter-lun). The one real e-commerce build in the corpus: payments, cart, configurator, 2.5 years of live maintenance, 445 own commits. Note: CV says Stripe/Vipps — evidence shows Stripe + Klarna, no Vipps anywhere in the repo.

what_it_is: One-week June 2023 prototype for the Lunnheim commission: product configurator experiments — color wheel ('Color Wheel Makes Me Spin Round Round'), horizontal wheel, phone mockup — on a Next 13 + Sanity template base.
frikk_role: Sole author; UX prototyping sandbox before the real build started a month later in lunnheim-2023.
evidence: components/ wheel.tsx, horizontal-wheel.tsx, product-configurator.component.tsx; commit log 2023-06-01..08
grade_why: Lunnheim family member — context only: shows the prototyping phase that fed the A-grade lunnheim-2023 build.

what_it_is: 'kult-starter-2023' — a reusable starter extracted from the Lunnheim stack (same author field 'Kult Byrå', same deps: Sanity react-loader, Stripe, tRPC, React Email, groqd). TASKLIST.md tracks de-Lunnheimification (making env vars optional, token renames).
frikk_role: Direction/review; Suman did the extraction work.
hardest_problems: Generalizing a client codebase into a starter.
grade_why: Lunnheim family member and boilerplate-lineage node: the client build fed back into a starter — the leverage loop running in reverse. Mostly Suman's commits.

what_it_is: Production client site for Myhre Smie (myhre-smie.no, Norwegian smithy/forge). Turborepo pnpm monorepo: apps/web (Next.js) + apps/studio (Sanity), based on the Kult starter lineage. 433 commits in 2022 alone.
frikk_role: Lead developer, 91% of commits, sustained over two-plus years.
hardest_problems: Full custom client site in a monorepo split (web + studio), long-tail maintenance.
evidence: apps/web/components/layout/footer.tsx (myhre-smie.no links), README ('Kult Next starter'), shortlog
grade_why: One of the largest single client builds in the corpus (491 commits, 447 his), and direct proof the boilerplate lineage fed client work — repo is literally named 'kult-starter-site' in package.json.

what_it_is: Frontend for Søyr, a Norwegian band: album pages, songs (sang), members (medlem), timeline (tidslinje), articles. Media-heavy — Mux video player, audio player, lightbox, Swiper. Next 12 pages-router on the Kult Sanity starter.
hardest_problems: Music/media presentation: video (Mux), audio playback, discography and band-timeline modeling in Sanity.
grade_why: A shipped, media-rich band site with distinctive content types (discography, timeline) — a proper dossier line, more interesting than a brochure site.

what_it_is: Sanity v2 studio companion to soyr-turbo: schemas, desk structure, Mux input, media plugin, content calendar, codegen config.
hardest_problems: Schema/codegen wiring for the band's content model.
grade_why: Søyr family member — studio half of the soyr-turbo site, context only.

what_it_is: Origin of the boilerplate lineage: 2021 Next.js + Sanity starter ('simple-site'), lerna monorepo with embedded studio/ dir, SendGrid contact mail, Tailwind + Sass.
frikk_role: Co-author (Suman-led, Frikk ~1/3 of commits); the agency's first shared starter.
hardest_problems: First-generation abstraction of the agency's site stack.
grade_why: Boilerplate-lineage root (2021). Its descendants — next-13-sanity-boiler, kult starters, client repos — carry the actual story; this is the ancestor.

what_it_is: Second-generation boilerplate, 373 commits over 2.5 years. Introduces the layered 'pagebuilder': 0-global-utilities / 1-page-types / 2-layout-parts / 3-blocks / 4-elements — a numbered altitude hierarchy for composing sites from CMS-driven blocks. i18n (document-internationalization, language-filter), theming (themer.d.ts), maps, SEO.
frikk_role: Lead author (70%); the pagebuilder architecture is the repo's core idea.
hardest_problems: Designing a reusable block/section architecture generic enough to feed many client sites — the 5-tier pagebuilder hierarchy is a deliberate answer to that.
grade_why: Boilerplate-lineage keystone. The leverage claim checks out: this and its 2021 ancestor visibly seeded Myhre-Smie ('kult-starter-site'), soyr-turbo ('Kult Byrå starter'), the Lunnheim stack (nextgen.config.json), and starter-lun. 373 commits invested in tooling that multiplied across every client build.

what_it_is: Sanity v2 studio for 'Slappa' (schemas split into documents/prebuilder + objects; desk structure; Google Maps input). Studio half of a client project whose frontend is elsewhere.
hardest_problems: Early 'prebuilder' schema pattern — precursor of the pagebuilder idea.
grade_why: Mostly Suman's studio scaffolding; only notable as an early sighting of the prebuilder/pagebuilder pattern in the boilerplate lineage.

what_it_is: Not a book — a Norwegian content site about how to write a book ('hvordan skrive bok'). Next 13 app-dir + Sanity personal-website template, with a parent/child category tree ('Children > Underkategorier') for structured article content — SEO-content-site shape.
hardest_problems: Hierarchical parent/child category structure in Sanity desk.
grade_why: Small solo content-site experiment; answers the charter question (a site about writing books, not a book). Context only.

what_it_is: Google Sheets API quickstart (the canonical OAuth 'listMajors' sample) in one index.js.
evidence: index.js is the Google quickstart verbatim

what_it_is: Answer to 'what is it': a personal web-gallery CMS for artists, in Norwegian. Two lives: a 2020-21 hobby site (30 commits), then resurrected in 2026 (181 commits) as a full product — Next.js 16 / React 19 + Convex realtime backend, Convex Auth with email reset via Resend, admin portal with CRUD for galleries/artists/collections/images/provenance/exhibitions, dnd-kit collage editor with smart layout scoring, data-* theme system. Has CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/backlog/ + tickettask bot — AI-agent-driven development workflow.
frikk_role: Sole author (bot commits aside); designer of the whole product.
hardest_problems: Fluid drag-and-drop collage editor with layout-scoring/aspect-ratio matching (2026-03 commits); art-domain data modeling (provenance, exhibition history); running dev through an agent workflow (tickettask bot, backlog/).
evidence: README.md, convex/, 'Fluid drag-and-drop collage editor' 2026-03-13, 'smart layout scoring' 2026-03-11, year histogram 22/8/181 (2020/2021/2026)
grade_why: Best resurrection story in the corpus: 2020 hobby project reborn in 2026 as a real niche product (artist gallery CMS) on a modern stack, solo, with visible hard UI work (collage engine) and an AI-native dev process. Canon candidate.

what_it_is: Two-day false start on a personal jarl.no site using the Tailwind UI 'Spotlight' template (MDX blog).
grade_why: Scaffolding; only value is dating an early jarl.no attempt.

what_it_is: Astro 5 + Sanity 4 + Tailwind 4 + React 19 + Shadcn monorepo boilerplate with a section-builder pattern; second commit 'Reorganize UI packages into 4-tier hierarchy' — the pagebuilder altitude idea again. Has AGENTS.md and conversation.txt: AI-generated in a sitting.
hardest_problems: None yet — value is the design lineage.
evidence: README, turbo.json, commit 'Reorganize UI packages into 4-tier hierarchy'
grade_why: Boilerplate-lineage continuation (2021 lerna -> 2022 pagebuilder -> 2023 kult starter -> 2025 Astro): same tiered-UI conviction, now produced in a day with AI instead of 373 commits.

evidence: package.json description, src/{client,types,examples}, wordpress/develon-api-proxy, bundled API manual PDF
grade_why: Unusual domain (construction-equipment telematics) and evidence of client integration work; context for the absent AG-Horizon-App.
